title: TigerBelly #29 DVDASA Dead? Asa Akira
summary: A roughly one-minute rapid multi-speaker TigerBelly #29 excerpt answering whether DVDASA is dead. The main response explicitly has no answer, does not know the future, and says the show is on a break while Dave focuses on other things, is doing well and was seen the previous week. The narrator describes DVDASA as an entire social life, self-identifies as a hermit who stays home roughly 90 percent of the time, says the weekly outing was good and is missed, then calls TigerBelly a new home. The archive preserves dated uncertainty and does not convert it into permanent cancellation, present status, diagnosis, surname or named turns.
